nodes.label: Forge (prompt-to-website builder)
nodes.rationale: Single Cloudflare Pages project hosts the app, serverless API proxy, D1 database, and shareable previews so all outbound API calls carry server-side keys and nothing sensitive reaches the browser.

nodes.label: Single Page Builder
nodes.rationale: Exactly one Claude call per page; client-side keyword extraction replaced the old research pipeline. Truncation is detected via stop_reason and retried once at higher max_tokens so a cut-off page is never returned silently.

nodes.label: Multi-Page Builder
nodes.rationale: A shared brand pass runs once per site and every page's generation call receives that brand brief so styling, tone, and nav stay consistent across pages.

nodes.label: Refine (edit existing page)
nodes.rationale: Model is told to change only what the plain-language instruction asks and keep the rest; one Claude call per refine with the same stop_reason truncation handling.

nodes.label: Lead Finder
nodes.rationale: Google Places API (New) Text Search, one API call per search with websiteUri in the field mask (no per-result Details calls), capped at 20 results to keep Enterprise-tier cost predictable. Businesses with no websiteUri become lead cards.

nodes.label: View History
nodes.rationale: Every business ever returned by a search with its current Yes/No/undecided status; never auto-clears.

nodes.label: Client Dashboard
nodes.rationale: The visible due-this-month list IS the v1 reminder system (no push notifications). One-tap mark-this-month-paid; deleting a client makes the business searchable again.

nodes.label: Revenue Dashboard
nodes.rationale: Windowed revenue = upfront fees by close date + monthly maintenance by when each month was marked paid, with an up/down trend vs the prior equivalent period.

nodes.label: Preview Links
nodes.rationale: Generated sites stored in D1 and served view-only at /preview/<id> on the same domain; no AI branding, no expiration, live until deleted.

nodes.label: My Sites gallery
nodes.rationale: Visual gallery of saved sites backed by the previews table with live thumbnails.

nodes.label: Proposal / Invoice generator
nodes.rationale: No-AI, instant, client-side printable proposal/invoice; remembers your own business name/contact in the browser.

nodes.label: Contact-form alerts
nodes.rationale: Generated site's form emails the lead's details via POST /api/contact with permissive CORS so it works on a client's own domain. Uses HMAC-signed tokens (no open relay), a honeypot for bots, and requires RESEND_API_KEY.

nodes.label: Cloudflare Pages Functions proxy
nodes.rationale: All outbound API calls (Anthropic and Google Places) go through Functions with server-side keys; nothing sensitive reaches the browser. Must run on Cloudflare Pages (Functions + D1); GitHub Pages is static-only.

nodes.label: D1 database
nodes.rationale: Tables: view_history, dismissed_leads, clients, client_payments, previews. client_payments is the source of truth for collected maintenance months. Previews stored directly in D1 since pages are far below per-row limits.

nodes.label: HMAC-signed contact tokens
nodes.rationale: Signed tokens prevent the contact endpoint from being an open email relay.

nodes.label: stop_reason truncation handling
nodes.rationale: Truncation detected via stop_reason and retried once at a higher max_tokens before surfacing a clear error, so a cut-off page is never returned silently.
